recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12453 unless Pharmacy later reopens the broader MedicationAdministration dosage invariant.
issue_request: FHIR-12453 was a Published / Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU2 MedicationAdministration asking to change mad-1 from wording that implied both dosage.dose and dosage.rate[x] were required to wording that allows either one.
initial_application: Jira comments marked the issue Applied and linked SVN/git commit a437487f804c183e181dbec98864b65bf2a86923. That commit changed the old MedicationAdministration spreadsheet invariant English from "dosage.dose and dosage.rate[x]" to "dosage.dose or dosage.rate[x]" while the FHIRPath expression already used dose.exists() or rate.exists().
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini, and the authoritative current source is source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml. The old spreadsheet source was later reworked into this StructureDefinition. Later Published issue FHIR-27834 broadened the same invariant to allow dosage.text as another way to satisfy present dosage, and FHIR-27834 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current mad-1 human text and FHIRPath expression require dosage.text, dosage.dose, or dosage.rate[x] with or semantics, preserving FHIR-12453 and the later FHIR-27834 refinement.

related_jiras.note: Same mad-1 invariant was later broadened to include dosage.text when dosage is present; already represented on the combined branch and used only as context.
